prompt_delivery_failed.action: inspect-transcript-and-terminal-first; repair-launch-topology-or-attach; confirm the previous attempt is not still writing before any retry

turn_start_unobserved.action: inspect-worker-show-and-terminal; if the task was accepted but never submitted, submit it in the same terminal; never re-dispatch from this evidence

readiness_failed.action: inspect-terminal-before-retry; confirm the previous attempt is not still writing before any retry

recoveryOrder: Repair the same agent's launch topology.
Retry only a confirmed failed or stopped attempt when allowed, and only after confirming the previous attempt is not still writing.
Use another supported model/effort on the same agent.
Use another agent profile at the same or higher quality tier — same provider only, unless the user authorized cross-provider fallback for this run.
Use a lower tier only if the Role minimum still passes.
Pause for user decision if the user pinned the unavailable choice, if crossing providers would be required without authorization, or if no eligible candidate remains.
crossProviderPolicy: Cross-provider fallback (a different agent family) suspends the affected Task for a user decision unless run-state records allowCrossProviderFallback=true with the user's authorization. Silence, a timeout, or an unverifiable attempt is never a reason to cross providers.
writeTaskHandoff: Confirm the original worker is stopped, failed, fenced, or explicitly handing off.
Capture git status, diff, commits, untracked files, and test state.
Start the replacement sequentially on the same safe state or a WIP snapshot branch.
Never run two writers on one task branch.
readOnlyRetry: Use unique attempt report paths and let the coordinator synthesize the final result.
userPinnedPolicy: No cross-agent or cross-model fallback without explicit user permission.
